dog.description_text:
Just in time for Halloween, meet Candy, an 11-week old, 3-pound (as of 10/31) sack of sugary-soft sweetness!
A true ginger boy, Candy is super friendly, very chatty, and always ready to play.

Candy spends his days hanging out with his kitten pals, practicing his hunting skills, and playing with crinkle toys and feather wands. He’s also a champion cuddler and a professional napper. The second Candy either gets food or a good snuggle, he turns into a loud purring machine. It’s absolutely adorable! And when he’s ready to rest, Candy will often fall sleep belly-up with his paws in the air. He definitely knows how to find the most comfortable positions.

This bright orange fella with the cutest white socks is fully litter-box trained, keeps himself very clean, and is not at all fussy at mealtime. He gets along well with everyone, including small children.

Candy would make a great addition to any home, particularly one where there are kids, adults or another friendly feline to horse around with.

If you would like to adopt Candy, comment ADOPT and we’ll send you an application.

If you would like to give this wonderful cat a home, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
